versions.changelog: Differentiates the listing from upstream: new display name and a summary that leads with what this fork adds over 1.2.2 (Garmin calendar, gated Jet Lag trips, extended metrics). No code change.

Security: confirmation gate on destructive trip operations. trip-delete and trip-update are now read-only by default (preview + exit 2); applying requires --confirm-delete / --confirm-update. Fixes the ClawHub security-audit finding.
SKILL.md now carries the README content: fork context, feature-diff table, scripts tree (incl. garmin_calendar.py), dual authorship, garminconnect>=0.3.18 pin.
Setup section modernised: Clawdbot -> OpenClaw, current config path (~/.openclaw/openclaw.json) and skill dir. Version strings aligned.
Calendar support (trips, races, events) and Jet Lag Adviser trips: create/replace/delete. Requires garminconnect >= 0.3.18. README rewritten; license corrected to Apache 2.0.

Garmin Health Analysis skill v0.1.0

- Initial release with natural language querying of Garmin health metrics.
- Supports 20+ health metrics including sleep, Body Battery, HRV, VO2 max, training readiness, and more.
- Tools for downloading FIT/GPX files and analyzing route, elevation, and pace.
- Fetch and analyze per-lap and per-second activity data.
- Generate interactive health dashboards and charts.
- Multiple configuration and authentication options, including UI, config file, and CLI.
